sentences.text: 2. Heard Sri Saurabh Shukla, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Sanjeev Kumar Singh, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and Sri Sunil Kumar Kushwaha, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The present application has been filed to quash the Case No. 720 of 2011, under Sections 498A,

sentences.text: Now, they have settled their dispute which was also reduced to written compromise dated 19.02.2025.
Copy of the same has been annexed as Annexure No.4 to the application.

It is further submitted that the aforesaid compromise has already been filed before the court below and a request has been made that on the basis of the written compromise, impugned proceedings may be quashed.
5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer on the ground that the aforesaid compromise is yet to be verified by the court below.

6. Considering the aforesaid submissions of both the parties, the present application is disposed of with direction to the court below to verify the aforesaid compromise after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receiving copy of this order.
After verification of the aforesaid compromise, court below will permit the parties to obtain certified copy of the same.
7. After verification of the compromise, court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.
8. For a period of two months, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
9. It is further provided that applicants are at liberty to file fresh application u/s 528 B.N.S.S., if required, to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified compromise.
